children: Nevada King bought C$8M of exchange-traded securities backed by physical gold, about 1,240 oz at an average ~$4,340/oz, and plans to hold for at least 12 months. Cash, short-term investments, and gold total about C$16M.
Shifts treasury exposure from cash to gold, adding commodity and FX sensitivity to liquidity.
Sets an implied cost basis; near-term gold moves will impact reported fair value.
Reduces near-term liquidity vs cash; marks to market may add P&L volatility.
Frames runway for exploration spend; limited buffer if gold declines.
Provides staggered liquidity via rolling maturies to fund operations.

This is an early-stage shift to align treasury with its gold exploration focus, adding non-operational exposure to gold prices. A larger catalyst would be a meaningful move in gold affecting treasury value or updates on Phase 4 drill results impacting funding needs.
